name: task-progress
description: Pane tracking the session's todo/task list with a progress bar, percent done and a citadel scene whose windows light as tasks finish

isSoundOn.title: Play a sound when all tasks are done
isSoundOn.description: Plays a short jingle once every task in the list is completed.

soundFile.title: Sound file
soundFile.description: Absolute path to your own audio file (wav/mp3/ogg). Empty uses the bundled jingle.

maxSeconds.title: Max sound length (seconds)
maxSeconds.description: A longer clip is cut after this many seconds (1-120).

isWaitSoundOn.title: Play a sound when another session starts waiting for you
isWaitSoundOn.description: Plays the same jingle once each time another session goes from busy to idle.
